title: Split array - Largest Sum
problemStatement: Split an array into k contiguous subarrays minimising the largest subarray sum.
intuition: Identical to book allocation: binary search the candidate maximum and greedily count the pieces needed.

approaches.title: Optimal: binary search on the largest sum
approaches.idea: Greedy chunking gives the minimum number of pieces for a cap.
approaches.dryRun:
[7,2,5,10,8] k=2 range [10,32]
cap=21 -> 2 pieces feasible
cap=15 -> 3 pieces infeasible
cap=18 -> 2 feasible -> 18

approaches.title: Alternative: interval DP
approaches.idea: dp[i][j] = min over split points; useful when k is small and values are tiny.
limitations: Only for small n; binary search dominates in practice

commonMistakes: Reaching for DP first and timing out
Wrong bounds on the search range
interviewInsight: Mentioning the DP alternative and why you reject it shows you chose rather than guessed.
